display_information.name: Artemis
display_information.description: Org-wide write-only pager for AI training. Routes scheduled Hermes review and escalation alerts to an engineer's DM by Slack member ID.
display_information.long_description: A single org-wide write-only pager for all engineers' local Hermes instances. It exists to tell an engineer one thing: when an automated review or task needs their eyes. It does not read Slack, it does not listen, it only pages; pages are routed to the intended engineer's DM by member ID (self-only enqueue).
